== Overview ==

The '''Xeno Scanner''' is a utility-mounted sensor designed to identify [[Thargoid]] vessels and reveal information that ordinary ship sensors do not provide. A passive target lock supplies basic identification data, while a completed active scan identifies the vessel more precisely and exposes targetable subtargets on applicable Thargoid craft.<ref name="axi-internals">[https://wiki.antixenoinitiative.com/en/optionals Optional Internals & Utility Modules], Anti-Xeno Initiative, accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

The stock specification data is current for the standard scanner. The module is distinct from the [[Enhanced Xeno Scanner]], which extends active-scan range to 2,000 m in the Live branch.<ref name="edcd-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/0db9234b5b9ce8c939ea84133d7ce336eea88e27/modules/hardpoints/xeno_scanner.json Coriolis data: Xeno scanners], Elite Dangerous Community Developers, commit 0db9234b5b9c, accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

== Operation ==

Assign the scanner to a fire group, select the Thargoid vessel, approach within 500 metres, and hold the scanner on target until the ten-second active scan completes. The target must remain within the scanner's forward cone and range throughout the scan.<ref name="edcd-data" /><ref name="xeno-wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/AX_Xeno_Scanner AX Xeno Scanner], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

A completed scan reveals the exact target variant and its available subtargets. On a [[Thargoid]] Interceptor, this includes heart subtargets and their status, allowing compatible gimballed and turreted weapons to lock onto an exerted heart directly.<ref name="axi-internals" /><ref name="xeno-wiki" /> The scan provides targeting information; it does not damage the target or exert a heart. A completed scan is not required to inflict damage with fixed weapons.

The standard scanner's short range and scan duration require the ship to remain close to the target. Commanders who need more stand-off distance in Live can use the [[Enhanced Xeno Scanner]], which Frontier introduced in January 3309.<ref name="frontier-enhanced">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/xeno-scanner-upgrade Xeno Scanner Upgrade], Frontier Developments, 27 January 2023.</ref>

== Acquisition and availability ==

The Xeno Scanner is a standard Outfitting purchase at stations that stock the module. It does not require a Technology Broker unlock.<ref name="xeno-wiki" />

The original scanner predates the Live and Legacy split and remains available in both branches. The Enhanced Xeno Scanner and later developments belong to the continuing Live branch; Legacy remains on version 3.8.<ref name="frontier-live-legacy">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/elite-dangerous-update-14-and-beyond-live-and-legacy-modes Elite Dangerous Update 14 and Beyond: Live and Legacy Modes], Frontier Developments, 29 November 2022.</ref>
